qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Statutory municipal gas distribution concession monopoly across Italy (>50% market share following 2i Rete Gas acquisition). Returns protected by ARERA inflation-indexed RAB framework.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (REJECT). Regulated Italian gas distributor carries extreme leverage (€10.4B debt vs €672M net income, >15x debt/NI) and sub-hurdle 7.2% ROIC due to ARERA-capped returns and continuous debt-funded capex dilution for 2i Rete Gas and network digitisation.
qualitative.evidence: ARERA regulates tariffs yielding a 4-year median GAAP ROIC of 7.17% (FY22: 5.9%, FY23: 6.8%, FY24: 7.5%, FY25: 8.0%). Following the €5.3B acquisition of 2i Rete Gas, net debt reached ~€9.9B to €11B against FY25 net income of €672.3M (14.7x net debt/NI), with interest coverage of 5.19x. Capex of €1.09B exceeds D&A of €712M, requiring perpetual debt refinancing and equity rights issues.
